definition.universe: perp_pit_v1 cohort, binance_um, 5 assets (BTC/ETH/BNB/SOL/XRP USDT-PERP), daily decision bars

entry_condition.btc_trend: BTC mark_price 20-bar log return > 0 (market-wide on/off switch)
entry_condition.optional_vol_amplifier: rv_pct >= 0.66 roughly doubles per-trade economics at 64% fewer trades

not_a_component: funding >=0.95 extreme slice (no non-monotone reversal, T79 E-arm)

evidence.asset_concentration: strongest on SOL/XRP; BTC/BNB ~null; ETH mixed

residual_risks.temporal_instability: fold1 test window negative under ALL gates; pooled rho 0.042 real but era-dependent (ridge fold rho: +0.009/-0.102/+0.026)
residual_risks.tail_driven: double-gate median ~0; mean carried by right tail
residual_risks.sparsity: tri-gate 110 trades over ~3.6yr x 5 assets (~6% cadence)
residual_risks.accounting_caveats: no market-impact model; funding accrual approximate; collapsed bid=ask=mark book

forbidden_interpretations: not a profitability or live-trading claim
not authorization to train RLCD or trade
not evidence the signal persists beyond the measured window
next_gate: RLCD review: use as conditioned state feature / sparse policy; requires new protocol + owner authorization before any model fitting
